_note: The ceiling on other leave encashment across employers and years (D-106; rulebook RET-LEAVE-AGG-001): the aggregate deduction for the tax year may not exceed A − B, where A is the notified limit (this row's amount) and B the amounts allowed in earlier years (LedgerSnapshot.leaveEncashmentAlreadyAllowed); the node forms A − B. TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.19(2)(f) (pp.45–46), "if any payment on account of cash equivalent of leave salary is received from one or more than one employer in the same tax year … the aggregate amount of deduction shall not exceed— A – B, where,— A = the limit specified by the Central Government, by notification; and B = the aggregate amount of payment or payments which was received in any one or more earlier tax years and allowed as an exemption or a deduction". TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.10(10AA)(ii) first and second provisos (thc.nic.in p.73), to the same effect. A: S.O. 2276(E), Rs. 25,00,000, the same notification as RET-LEAVE-ENCASHMENT-OTHER's limit. Every regime.
